actions: kernel/device/driver metadata only; no GPIO request or values/config writes
command:
set -eu
echo META_START; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime; uname -r
echo PINCTRL_DRIVER
for p in /sys/bus/platform/devices/4630000.pinctrl/driver /sys/bus/platform/devices/4630000.pinctrl/driver/module /sys/class/gpio/gpiochip120/device; do echo "$p"; readlink -f "$p" || true; done
echo PINCTRL_DEVICE_METADATA
for n in modalias uevent; do p=/sys/bus/platform/devices/4630000.pinctrl/$n; if test -r "$p"; then echo "$n"; cat "$p"; fi; done
echo RELEVANT_MODULES
awk '/pinctrl|gpio|sdp/ {print}' /proc/modules
echo PINCTRL_CAPABILITIES
if test -r /sys/kernel/debug/pinctrl/pinctrl-devices; then cat /sys/kernel/debug/pinctrl/pinctrl-devices; else echo UNREADABLE; fi
echo META_END; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
